policy: The certified June UK national battery declared as data (microcosm#611): the two build preflights plus the terminal battery. Every gate carries its thresholds as entry parameters at exact certified or receipted values; microcosm#630 landed the weighted-integrity pair as reviewed parameter edits with receipts in the entry notes, and the weight-ratio fence keeps its exact certified June value (the #630 breach was an SPI allocation defect fixed upstream in microcosm#710). The #680 stochastic layer delivers the take-up signal gate; every gate the UK runs today is declared below.

gates.notes: Frameless preflight mirror of the US cheap preflight: the committed coverage manifest must match the engine's current variable surface, aborting before source stages on graph or reference drift.
Frameless preflight over the materialized stage names: every family the coverage manifest marks required_at_build must have its build stage scheduled before any stage runs.
Ledger-compiled UK targets at period 2023 compared with the certified production 2023 calibration surface fixture. Signed differences are committed for adjudication rather than hidden.

Ledger-compiled UK targets at the 2025 calibration period compared with the frozen incumbent registry surface. The signed list enumerates TCL additions, exclusions, unsupported rows, and vintage drift for review.

Ledger-compiled UK local-area targets at the 2025 calibration period compared with the frozen incumbent local registry surface. The incumbent's out-of-contract devolved private-rent and council-tax columns remain fixture-only and are signed with ruled rationales.

Structural, valueless local default-surface check: compose metric_names(area_type) over the committed local crosswalk roster and apply the signed area deferrals from local_target_reference_membership.json as reviewed exclusions.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the WAS wealth receipt; raw FRS mapping stages have no imputation semantics and intentionally have no empty health gate. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. private_pension_wealth joined the gated columns with microcosm#1063 (it had been an output without an allowance); the derived totals are clipped like every other column, and a clipped total would also break its identity in the wealth_coherence gate.

Stage-time coherence gate over the WAS wealth receipt (microcosm#1063). Zero rows may carry a main-residence mortgage off the mortgaged tenure or main_residence_value off an owner tenure: both columns are fitted and drawn inside their tenure stratum, so a non-zero count is a defect of the stage, not of a draw; mortgage_debt itself is the main-residence mortgage plus the mortgages on other property, held on any tenure. Every derived total must equal its components on every row (property_wealth, corporate_wealth, gross_financial_wealth, mortgage_debt, and net_financial_wealth as gross less consumer debt and the student loan balance); the stage derives them, so only a support clip of a total can open a gap, and the support gate allows none. The weighted share of owner households without a main-residence value may exceed the donor's own share by at most the reviewed excess (the donor's share is zero on the pinned round-8 tab, where every owner reports a value). The receipt's donor comparisons (positive shares by tenure, the mortgaged share owing more than the main-residence value, the mortgage mass held off the mortgaged tenure on each side) and the rows the donor-range cap adjusted are recorded in the details and carry no threshold.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the WAS Lifetime ISA receipt (microcosm#1003): the balance is drawn from the QRF fitted on the credible donor holders, so every draw lies inside their realised range and non-holders are zero; the zero allowances make any clip a signal.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the NTS bus-travel receipt (microcosm#930): the band is an ordinal the QRF draws inside the donor's 0..6 and the trips are the donor's band means, so no row can clip; the zero allowances make any clip a signal.

Stage-time fact check on the NTS bus-travel receipt (microcosm#930), every published value recomputed from the vendored rows: the frame's prior-weighted share of persons who use a local bus at least yearly against the vendored NTS0313 all-ages share (maximum_user_share_deviation, in points), and the frame's mean local-bus trips per person per series against the vendored NTS0303 rate of the declared year (maximum_trip_rate_deviation, relative). The tolerances are rules set above what a conditional draw on the FRS composition can be expected to reproduce, not observed maxima; the stage runs on a synthetic donor in the smoke build, so the entry is a population fact check that a synthetic smoke records without blocking on. Car availability against NTS0205 is a receipt line, not a check: a mismatch there is a was_wealth finding.

Stage-time realization check over region incidence, latent-rate bands, normalized deduction-type combinations, and the exact latent/type/incidence coherence identity. Tolerances are derived from each receipt cell's realized row count; missing evidence blocks.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the LCFS receipt. The exempt energy columns are deliberately named here because they are bridged through the NEED/WAS path rather than clipped to LCFS donor support. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. Bus fares are clipped before the pricing step (microcosm#890 and #930, María's rulings 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-17): the clip bounds the region no area prices (Wales keeps the chain's raw draw) at donor support, the priced regions then move beyond it as journeys times the published yield, and the column carries no committed terminal support bound.

Stage-time energy check (microcosm#890 F, chronicle#270). María's ruling (2026-09-15, PR #927): 'I'm not sure why we are comparing against NEED as a gate in the first place if that is not what we are calibrating, but I agree we should implement Vahid's recommended fix and move the fix to before calibration.' Fact checks on the lcfs energy_rake receipt, every published value recomputed at gate time from the vendored rows the stage declares: each cell's shape target is the vendored NEED 2024 mean (need_energy_facts.json, margins_period_value), each fuel's level is the vendored DESNZ Energy Trends domestic consumption at actual temperature over the four FY2024-25 quarters (desnz_domestic_energy_facts.json) with the level factor equal to that total over the frame's pre-level total and the levelled frame total equal to the published one, each cell's target is shape times factor, and every region with a published gas-connected share (DESNZ subnational gas meters over electricity meters, 2024) sits within 0.5 points of it after the imposition unless the draw could not fill it (a receipted shortfall). The residual check holds the maximum absolute relative deviation of any cell mean from its levelled target, per margin (income band, tenure, property type, region) and fuel, electricity over every household of a cell and gas over its gas-connected households, to one fixed 2.5 % tolerance on the IPF's cross-margin residual (region is swept last and fits to machine precision by construction, so the tolerance binds the earlier three; a declared rule set above the observed maxima, not a fact: spine-s3 on NEED 2023 showed income 1.65 %, tenure 1.29 %, accommodation 0.83 %; spine-s5 on the NEED 2024 shape with the published connection showed income 2.16 % electricity / 1.97 % gas, accommodation 1.46 %, tenure 1.31 %, which is why the 2 % rule of spine-s3 moved to 2.5 %). This gate replaced the two NEED mean-spend anchors that uk_aggregate_admin measured on the calibrated frame; the calibrated frame is held to the bound ONS 04.5.1 electricity and 04.5.2 gas rows, and the gap between the DESNZ-volume-times-QEP-price level the stage sets and the ONS national-accounts spend is the published-source residual PR #927 receipts Part T records, not a gate. The entry is a population_fact_check: a synthetic smoke build (the staging smoke over the H2 fixture) records its outcome without blocking, because the fixture is not the population NEED, DESNZ and the meter counts describe; every licensed build blocks on it. Tolerance governance (Vahid's third pass on PR #927): maximum_relative_deviation is a rule set above the observed maxima, not a fact; the rake runs a fixed number of sweeps and the receipt now records the cross-margin residual after every sweep (sweep_residuals), so the terminal residual is shown converged, not truncated, and a vintage whose converged residual exceeds the rule is a new ruling for María, never a silent re-pin. The gate checks the convergence rather than asserting it (Vahid's review of microcosm#1012): across the last convergence_window_sweeps (10) sweeps each fuel's residual may range, maximum minus minimum, by at most maximum_residual_change_over_window (0.1 point of relative deviation), so a rake oscillating inside the window fails as a truncated one does; the window presupposes the stage declares more sweeps than the window is long, and the stage refuses an undeclared sweep count. On the licensed spines the 50-sweep receipts of main and of the SPI-first reorder were still falling 0.11 to 0.75 points over their last 10 sweeps, while the 200-sweep receipt of microcosm#1012's final head moves 0.014 points. maximum_connected_share_deviation is declared, not derived from the walk: the greedy weight-fitting walk lands within a fraction of one household weight of the published share, and the check is waived only for a region whose draw cannot fill its published share (the shortfall is receipted and reported here), never for a region above it. The regions the crosswalk maps to no subnational area are declared on the stage (connection_fallback_regions, Northern Ireland) and refused if they differ from the crosswalk.

Stage-time fact check on the lcfs bus_pricing receipt (microcosm#930): every area's receipts, boardings, concessionary journeys, trips per resident and population, and the boardings-per-trip and yield factors derived from them, are recomputed from the vendored rows the stage declares and must equal the receipt's; the unpriced regions must be the declared ones (Wales, which keeps the chain's raw draw by María's ruling of 2026-09-17) and the chain must have conditioned on the raw draw. The frame-implied boardings over the published ones are reported per area, not fenced: that ratio is the survey-versus-admin reading the bound receipts targets then act on. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time check on the lcfs road_fuel_incidence receipt (microcosm#1113): the redraw ran with the declared rule, seed, salt and trees; after it no household the fuel flag marks as buying petrol or diesel carries zero road fuel and no unflagged household carries any; the total model fitted the positive-only regime. The chain's zero share among flagged households is the two-week diary's artefact the step corrects (about a third at prior weights on the 2026-10-08 spine); above one half the chain itself would be at fault, so the gate fails there instead of redrawing it away. María's ruling of 2026-10-08 set every fuel-car household to a positive annual spend. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time fact check on the lcfs road_fuel_level receipt (microcosm#1113): the ONS Consumer Trends COICOP 07.2.2 household spend the stage declares is recomputed from the vendored row and must equal the receipt's, and the prior-weighted petrol plus diesel after the step must equal it less the donor's other-fuels share, with the factor reproducing that from the drawn total. The other-fuels share is the LCFS donor's own c72213 share of 07.2.2, licensed microdata the gate cannot recompute, so it is bounded at five percent instead (0.37 percent on the 2023-24 diary). María's ruling of 2026-10-08 set the stage, not the weights, as what levels household road fuel. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time check on the lcfs recomposed_totals receipt (microcosm#1113): housing_water_and_electricity_consumption and transport_consumption each keep their own chain draw less the chain's draws of the parts the stage re-levels (the drawn electricity and gas, or petrol and diesel; floored at zero where the parts outgrow the total) and add the levelled parts back, so no household's total is below its electricity and gas or its petrol and diesel and no remainder is negative. The declared parts must be the receipt's, the weighted remainder must equal the drawn total less the drawn parts plus the floored mass, and the weighted total the remainder plus the levelled parts, to the declared tolerance. The ONS 04.5.3 and 04.5.4 liquid and solid fuel spend, which stays inside the housing remainder because no frame column carries it, is recomputed from the vendored rows and must equal the receipt's. The two totals carry no committed support bound; this check holds them instead. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time check that every household spend column lcfs_consumption emits is at calendar-2024 prices as households paid them (microcosm#1113): the H5's year, which policyengine-uk projects every column from with calendar-year growth and the calibration uprates to the calendar-2025 window, so no column needs a basis of its own. The donor uprating must move the diary to 2024, the QEP energy prices and the DESNZ volume level must be for calendar 2024, bus fares must be re-priced to 2024 by the fares indices, and the road-fuel level must be ONS 07.2.2 for calendar 2024; a step whose receipt is absent fails. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the ETB VAT receipt. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the ETB services receipt. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. Bus support is exempt since microcosm#890: the declared rake to the published net support sets its level. Since microcosm#930 (María's ruling of 2026-09-23 retiring the support rake) bus_subsidy_spending is clipped like the other two columns before the pricing step overrides it outside Wales and Northern Ireland, so it carries the same zero allowances and is no longer exempt.

Stage-time fact check on the ETB bus-support pricing receipt (microcosm#930; the #890 rake to the published net support retired on María's ruling of 2026-09-23): every declared support area's concessionary travel reimbursement, net support, boardings and concessionary boardings (DfT BUS05bi and BUS01 for London and England outside London, Scottish Transport Statistics for Scotland) and the per-boarding rates derived from them are recomputed from the vendored rows through the stage's own declaration and must equal the receipt's; the raw-draw regions (Wales, Northern Ireland) must be the declared ones and the pricing must be applied on the chain's raw draw. The priced support against the published net support is reported, not fenced: the calibration targets act on it. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time source-signal gate over the retained FRS/HMRC leaves receipt. hmrc_spi_incapacity_benefit_income is the E7 reviewed-absent adjudication (microcosm#683, 2026-08-18): the FRS 2024-25 source carries no incapacity-benefit signal, the stage's own fence raises at build time if a future vintage does, and the reviewed list here makes the battery agree with that adjudication instead of re-litigating it every build.
Stage-time mass gate over the SPI support-channel receipt: the channel's prior share of households without a member at or over State Pension age, and its share of those with one (microcosm#1069).
Stage-time SPI redraw identity gate over the HMRC SPI income spine receipt.

Stage-time structural gate over the SPI benefit coherence receipt (microcosm#1095, uk-data#514): no SPI-channel row keeps a zeroed legacy report, every restored report equals the FRS twin's, receives_benefits_in_own_right agrees with each person's own reports, FRS rows are unchanged, every SPI benefit unit with a Universal Credit reporter claims, and no SPI unit outside the Universal Credit age population claims without reporting.

Stage-time gate over the Pension Credit take-up receipt (microcosm#1069 R9): each component band (Guarantee Credit, Savings Credit only) realizes its DWP FYE 2024 caseload take-up within 0.05 at the stage's weights, or at least the rate where its reporters alone exceed it. The terminal take-up signal gate no longer measures would_claim_pc, whose rate is a share of the entitled units the engine finds, not of every benefit unit.

Stage-time gate over the Child Benefit take-up receipt (microcosm#1063): the share of eligible children claimed for is within 0.02 of HMRC's published claim rates by single year of age (Table 15, May 2025) at the frame's age mix, and within 0.05 at each age with at least 200 child rows whose solved rate was not clipped (clipped ages are reported); the opted-out share of claiming families is within 0.01 of the published opted-out share of registered families (August 2025), or below it only where the charged families are exhausted. The terminal take-up signal gate no longer measures would_claim_child_benefit or child_benefit_opts_out, whose rates are shares of eligible children and of claiming families, not of every benefit unit.
Stage-time conservation gate over the CGT incidence clone receipt.

Stage-time gate over the CGT support split receipt (microcosm#1045). Total household mass is conserved to the declared deviation; every copy weighs at most the declared maximum; each income column's support mass equals clone_split_factor x headroom x the published count of gainers at or above GBP 250,000 in that column; the selected mass covers the support mass unless the column's pool is exhausted, in which case the whole pool is selected and the exhaustion is recorded rather than refused (five of six columns exhaust on the synthetic smoke fixture). The split supplies row support at the top of the gains distribution for the Table 3 redraw and assigns no value, so it holds no distributional threshold.

Stage-time support gate for spi_income_band_donors (PolicyEngine/chronicle#280 lane; mass-conserving since microcosm#1063): every HMRC Table 2.5 band from GBP 200,000 carries reserved donor households with one carrier each at equal positive weight no greater than the declared maximum, and the bands are exactly the declared four. The donors' mass is reallocated from the households of each donor's region: total household mass is conserved to the declared deviation and no region's incumbents are scaled below the declared funding factor. At full scale every band seats its planned count (never fewer than the minimum) and carries its published taxpayers to the declared deviation; a full-sample build must be at full scale, and a small frame records its seating and mass scales instead.
Stage-time CGT redraw summary gate wired through the existing UKCGTImputationSummary receipt rather than fabricating a terminal support verdict.

Stage-time gate over the CGT residential split receipt (microcosm#1063). The split carries the solved residential probability as weight: every household with liable gainers becomes arms whose weights are products of p and 1 - p, one arm per subset of residential gainers, the arm with no residential gainer keeping the household's ids. Total household mass is conserved to the declared deviation; the logistic solve reproduces the Table 8a 2024-25 totals on the individuals basis within the solve tolerance; the residential count and gains at design weights equal the solved expectations in every HMRC gain band to the identity tolerance (an arithmetic identity, not a realisation); every arm weight is its declared product; the arms created match the households by liable gainers; and no household carries more liable gainers than the declared maximum. The details carry the arm-weight distribution and the share of the residential gains on the largest arm stakes.

Stage-time gate over the CGT asset-type receipt (microcosm#725, #1014): the residential arms the cgt_residential_split stage left carry the Table 8a 2024-25 totals on the individuals basis at design weights within the solve tolerance (microcosm#1063 carries the solved residential probability as weight, so nothing is drawn here and no walk bound applies), and every gain band row of the residential receipt is finite and sums to the receipt. Each Table 4.1 2024-25 BADR band is held to deterministic bounds only: its solve to the band's published claimant count and qualifying gains (the open top band to the published gains over the lifetime limit), its realised count within the band pool's largest weight, its realised qualifying gains within that weight times (2 max gain - min gain) of the band pool below the limit and exactly the limit times the realised count in the top band; every BADR invariant (claimants outside the non-residential liable pool, qualifying gains above the net gain or the limit or outside the band, residential overlap, sub-AEA claimants) must be zero and the main-type fits (one per claimant status since microcosm#1063) must have converged. Every liable gainer carries an asset type and the Table 7 composition receipt is finite; the calibration binds the residential totals and the Table 4.1 bands.

Stage-time gate over the CGT incidence anchor receipt (microcosm#970). Clone-side receipt: the groups, targets and masses are clone households paired to originals; band donors and originals are outside the anchor, so this gate certifies the anchor's own arithmetic against its declared composition, not a population count. The sub-exempt and loss-making clone groups sit at the reporter-composition targets derived from the redrawn liable mass whenever they were trimmed, never overshoot or gain mass, and stay untouched when already at or below target; zero-gain clone carriers are no reporters and are left untouched; liable clone mass is byte-identical before and after; every clone/original pair conserves its mass to floating-point rounding; the clone side never exceeds the original side; and at least one pair exists. The level is a modelling assumption (HMRC publishes no count below the exempt amount), so the gate fixes the anchor to its own declared composition rather than to a published target.
Stage-time realization gate over salary_sacrifice's own headcount receipt.

Stage-time gate over the per-plan student-loan top-up receipts (microcosm#1049). The stage realises each plan's shortfall against the pinned SLC liable stock by an identity-keyed greedy walk: eligible persons in ascending stable-uniform order, taken when their weight fits inside the remaining shortfall, skipped when it would overshoot, and the skipped person nearest the remainder taken afterwards if that brings the realised mass nearer the shortfall (the gas-connection walk's rule). The gate checks what the walk controls: the realised top-up sits within the lightest skipped person's weight of the shortfall, and the plan's final England count within maximum_stock_relative_deviation (5 percent) of the stock. A pool lighter than the shortfall must have been taken whole, and its attainment is recorded rather than refused: on the licensed spine PLAN_2's eligible pool holds about 2.0m people against a 7.5m shortfall (final England count 3.4m against the 8.94m stock), a gap between what the SLC liable stock counts and what the FRS carries that the stage cannot close. A plan already at or above its stock is left as reported and recorded. Every receipt field is required and the receipt must be self-consistent, so a partial or tampered receipt fails closed. This replaces a relative-deviation check on a Bernoulli increment, which refused every spine since #1006: PLAN_5's shortfall had shrunk to 817 people, about one survey person's weight, so the draw's outcome of zero or two rows was off by around 100 percent whichever way it fell (1.10 against the 1.0 rule), while the final count (10,901 against 10,000) was acceptable and unchecked. The synthetic smoke build over the H2 fixture cannot reach either stock and records both pools as exhausted.

Stage-time achieved-versus-target gate over the age-tail disaggregation receipt. At its post-frs_spine position, achieved_weighted measures raw FRS-grossed 80+ mass before clone or zero-weight support channels exist.

Stage-time invariants over the #791 relationship receipt: exactly one HEAD per household agreeing with hrpid and hrpnum, contiguous person numbers, no person with two partners, no unmapped relhrp code, family index and enum domains consistent, and the ten-cell household-type partition covering every household exactly once. The grid reciprocity tolerance is the reviewed 2024-25 tape count; a re-issued tape with a different count refuses for review.
The release input-coverage contract over the built frame: required columns present and populated per the committed manifest resource in this package.

No constant non-structural columns on any entity table. Reviewed exclusions come from the committed schema-2 register (the microcosm#630 source-year adjudication landed there via microcosm#658, approval receipt with expiry included); the battery runs the same policy of record the terminal report resolves.

Effective sample size of the positive household weights must stay above one percent of the positive-weight count (microcosm#609). Evaluated on family-folded weights since microcosm#1045 (each cgt_support_split root with its copies summed, the quantity the certification measured on a frame without copies), with the row-level summary reported beside it.

Exact certified June measurement (max positive weight over positive median), an acceptance fence with no discretionary headroom. The microcosm#630 finding-2 breach (1590.53) was adjudicated NOT a re-baseline case: adversarial decomposition showed 11-12 SPI-synthetic clone rows from two donor lineages carried pathological inherited weights, fixed upstream by the per-stratum allocation in microcosm#710 (post-fix full-scale ratio well inside this fence). The fence held and stays at the June bound; raising it requires an explicit future adjudication with a receipted measurement, never loosen-to-pass. Evaluated on family-folded weights since microcosm#1045 (each cgt_support_split root with its copies summed, the quantity this June measurement was taken on), with the row-level summary reported beside it: the split's light copies halve the row-level median without moving the maximum.

Every fit-produced weight column carries a completed audit record. Armed by the SPI income stage; an absent audit is not a passing audit — and blocks every posture, not only release candidates: the legacy schema-3 path's strictness, ported during the #654 retirement (microcosm#691 review).
Every UK source-stage column declared in source_stages.json nonnegative_outputs must be finite and non-negative on the terminal frame; this makes the shared nonnegative column gate live for UK.

Benunit-aggregated reported Universal Credit must imply would_claim_uc. The reported-capital engine carrier is bounded below by its named -1 unavailable sentinel, may use that sentinel only where the FRS carrier is unavailable, and otherwise remains the exact same source value.

Every WAS/LCFS/ETB imputed output covered by support clipping must remain inside committed disclosure-safe donor support bounds. Exact donor ranges are used in-run for clipping; this release gate uses outward-rounded reviewed bounds so unit-record donor minima and maxima are never committed. The nts_bus_travel person outputs (band and annual trips) are bounded by the NTS donor's ranges since microcosm#930. The was_lisa person balance is bounded by the WAS person donor's credible holders since microcosm#1003.

Release-blocking aggregate-admin gate for the NHS budget. The two NEED energy anchors left this gate under microcosm#890 by María's ruling (2026-09-15, PR #927): 'I'm not sure why we are comparing against NEED as a gate in the first place if that is not what we are calibrating, but I agree we should implement Vahid's recommended fix and move the fix to before calibration.' NEED is checked where the rake acts, at prior weights, by uk_stage_lcfs_consumption_energy_rake; the calibrated frame is held to the bound ONS 04.5.1 electricity and 04.5.2 gas rows (per fuel since chronicle #271). Known and now unchecked after calibration: the calibrated NEED means sat at GBP 824 / 688 against the anchors' GBP 1,082 / 850 (-24 % / -19 %) because NEED kWh priced at the FY2024-25 cap (about GBP 52bn at design weights) and ONS 04.5 (GBP 43.4bn) disagree by roughly 20 % on this frame (PR #927 receipts Parts N-Q). The build supplies SDC-safe measured aggregates as evidence; the gate checks signs and tolerances.

reviewed_exclusions.person.incapacity_benefit_reported: The enhanced FRS stores this legacy reported-benefit input as an all-zero layer; the candidate must drop dead zero layers.

gates.notes: Reviewed candidate-only fields from the June UK prototype (source provenance or genuine additional model inputs, not incumbent-surface losses) plus the one reviewed reference-side exclusion. The two hard-required columns that may never be waived stay a code-level guard, per the microcosm#327 rule that a parity comparison's registers are declared inputs. During the migration window the runtime merges the exclusion register with the legacy constant and the spec-pin tests hold the two equal; the register becomes solely load-bearing when the constant retires.

Every contract-driven stochastic flag must be non-constant and have a weighted share within +/-0.05 of its contract target. would_claim_pc is measured by uk_stage_pension_credit_take_up instead (microcosm#1069 R9), and would_claim_child_benefit and child_benefit_opts_out by uk_stage_child_benefit_take_up (microcosm#1063). would_claim_uc is drawn for FRS benefit units by frs_take_up and redrawn for SPI-channel units by spi_benefit_coherence on the same rule (microcosm#1095), so the gate measures both channels at the contract rate.

The household BRMA assignment must remain inside the PolicyEngine-UK brma enum domain. Evaluated at the assembled boundary, right after frs_brma writes the column: enum membership is a property of the values themselves, so checking it there is identical to checking it at the end and refuses fourteen stages earlier. Take-up signal stays terminal by contrast, because its weighted shares are not the same statistic before and after calibration.

The household ONS household-type value must be one of the ten Chronicle ons.household_type value ids the frs_relationships stage declares (the build supplies the declared domain as evidence; the column is a frame input, not a PolicyEngine-UK enum). Evaluated at the assembled boundary like the BRMA enum: membership is a property of the values themselves.

The person capital_gains_asset_type value must be one of the eight values the hmrc_cgt_asset_type_spine stage declares (none, sub_aea, the Chronicle Table 7 asset-type value ids); the build supplies the declared domain as evidence because the column is a frame input, not a PolicyEngine-UK enum (microcosm#725). Evaluated at the transferred boundary, after the stage that writes the column has run.
The benefit-unit UC deduction combination must remain inside PolicyEngine-UK's UCDeductionCombination enum domain.
The person student-loan plan assignment must remain inside the PolicyEngine-UK StudentLoanPlan enum domain.
Every activated UK national target reference must resolve and enter the calibration matrix; count mismatch blocks release.

The solve's realized target surface must equal the declared register exactly, at name-and-period grain; the gate takes no tunable parameters. The reference side is the declared register, not an incumbent-derived surface — the frozen parity instrument carries input-column shares only — so this proves that every declared target was bound at its declared period, not agreement with the incumbent.
Every calibration target within twenty-five percent absolute relative error, the certified June acceptance bound.

Projection fence over the calibrated frame's sub-exempt gainers (microcosm#970). The engine freezes the annual exempt amount at its nominal value and uprates capital_gains by OBR per-capita GDP growth, so a gainer at or just below the exempt amount in the build period becomes a CGT taxpayer in a later projected year without any change in behaviour. For every year to the horizon the gate counts the cumulative stock of build-period sub-exempt gainers (gains in (0, exempt amount]) whose gains, uprated by the cumulative growth factor to that year, exceed that year's exempt amount; the stock is non-decreasing in the year, so the horizon year carries the largest count. The bound is the vendored HMRC Table 2.1a count of 2024-25 taxpayers with gains from 3,000 to 5,999 (73,000): people already above the exempt amount, not entrants, so the bound is a plausibility ceiling (the population of the thinnest liable band), not a published entrant count. The horizon 2030 is the last year of the OBR per-capita growth path in the engine's parameter tree; later years repeat the 2030 rate, so a longer horizon would only compound a constant. The growth path and the exempt amount by year the seam reads from the installed engine are pinned here and drift-checked (the exempt amount was 6,000 in 2023-24 and 3,000 from 2024-25, so a 2023-period frame's base year reads 6,000), so an engine bump cannot move the verdict silently and re-pinning is a reviewed change; without an installed engine the seam builds the projection from these pins and the receipt says so. The margin is thin by construction: on the first rebuilt candidate the stock ran from 12.7k in 2025 to 67.6k in 2030, about 13k a year, and 61k of the 67.6k were band donors the redraw had demoted below the exempt amount, a separate decision; the anchored clones contributed 6.4k. The v20 candidate would have failed with 10.8 million in the first projected year. The bound comes from the same vendored facts the amounts stage is pinned to, never from a literal.

gates.notes: Weighted input-mass parity against the active named reference in the registry, with reviewed exclusions scoped per reference so a channel-blind reference exclusion does not suppress comparison against a future channel-aware reference. The tolerance is the worst surviving measured drift at the reviewed floor, exact, with no headroom; the reviewed per-reference exclusions (charitable_investment_gifts, signed at +15,168.8% on the post-#710 surface; owned_land, signed for seed variance) were retired on 2026-09-22 when the first release-cut certification measured both inside the fence (-99.0% and -73.5% against the enhanced FRS reference, microcosm#967); the register is empty and the gate's current failures are the two genuine breaches it names. The 0.0 floor excludes only arithmetically meaningless zero-mass denominators. Totals stay uncommitted under the UKDS licence, supplied per-run and pinned by totals_sha256; missing sidecar evidence records evidence_absent. Totals keys are flat frame column names since the #611 A4 dedup; that digest re-freeze was keys-only against the #610 values (identity unchanged, values byte-identical). Sensitivity floor, recorded rather than silent (microcosm#706 review): the tolerance is the worst surviving measured drift, and that edge is currently set by a column whose deviation is explained (vintage plus SPI composition, microcosm#703's head-to-head receipt), so at this value the gate is a gross mass-loss/explosion fence rather than a regression detector — the compared population sits at median 0.24 and p90 0.63. Tightening runs through this register: each explained top drift that earns a receipt lets the tolerance re-mint at the worst unexplained survivor, with the full distribution and the exclusions-versus-tolerance tradeoff in experiments/630-uk-gate-adjudication-receipts.md.

Weighted tail-concentration audit of the QRF-imputed output columns derived from the HMRC source manifest. Armed from the #686 L3 baselines per #757 B4, each threshold recording the run that measured it: the 47-column qrf_tail grids of uk_weighted_integrity_baselines_686.json (sha256 8b3f6c4e9c522445bf3e05d3451ee8557f4e14d25524ceac3af8bfe05401a146, licensed acceptance dir 686-spine-swap), measured on spine-a.h5 (sha256 a65f2132736d1dcecb91709a513a0d54a5887635ea03760629cc888d188ee306, 113,649 person rows, design weights) for the #609/#578 threshold adjudication. top_k 100 is the measurement grid anchor [10, 100, 500, 1000]; max_top_share is the exact measured maximum over the checked surface (hmrc_spi_other_social_security_income, 104 carriers), no headroom; min_nonzero_records is the thinnest measured column above the grid anchor (the same column) - the policy domain requires min_nonzero_records > top_k, so the three saturated sub-anchor columns (hmrc_spi_taxable_termination_pay 12, charitable_investment_gifts 22, sda_reported 24 carriers, each top-100 share 1.0) sit below it and go thin visibly in the signed details on every run, never a silent pass. The baselines are design-weight measurements and the terminal gate runs on the calibrated release frame; a calibrated-weight breach names its column and is a finding, not noise. The 12 household_qrf_tail grids (was_wealth surface) are measured in the same baselines file and not yet armed - a household-surface gate entry is a declared follow-up.
